intro: Wednesday brings a South Coast travel warning, a robot-training walkthrough and changes to GitHub notifications. Tuesday’s market close, a January concert, an AI community gathering and a North Vancouver menu offer more to plan around.

stories.title: BC warns of wind and flooding on South Coast routes
stories.summary: BC is advising drivers to prepare for wind, debris and possible flooding through Thursday in coastal areas including Metro Vancouver and Howe Sound. Road closures could come with little notice; check DriveBC before travelling.

stories.title: A walking robot learns to steer around obstacles
stories.summary: An Nvidia tutorial describes training an obstacle-avoidance controller for the Microduck robot in simulation while keeping its walking policy fixed. It covers simulated sensing, policy export and deployment on the physical robot.

stories.title: GitHub plans a notification migration
stories.summary: GitHub will begin migrating GitHub.com notifications on December 1 over the course of a week. The company says the change is intended to make subscriptions more predictable and correct unexpected notification behaviour.

stories.title: A guide examines how to maintain agent benchmarks
stories.summary: Hugging Face published a guide to building and maintaining evaluations for AI agents, from defining tasks and checking scores to reviewing claims and releasing components. A worked example applies the process to an agentic physics-lab task.

stories.title: GitHub flags invalid coverage report formats
stories.summary: GitHub’s code coverage upload action now fails when a report is not in the supported Cobertura XML format. Developers whose workflows fail can configure their test framework to produce that format or convert the report before uploading.

stories.title: US indexes diverge after Monday’s rally
stories.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.50% and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 1.48% Tuesday, while the Dow gained 0.85%. The split followed Monday’s broad rebound and left investors with a mixed close across major US indexes.

events.date: 2027-01-23 · 6:30 p.m. · Kerrisdale Presbyterian Church, 2733 West 41st Avenue, Vancouver
events.title: A candlelit concert enters Peaky Blinders territory
events.description: Candlelight: Peaky Blinders brings an evening of live music to Kerrisdale Presbyterian Church. The January 23 performance is listed for 6:30 p.m.; the event page has tickets for advance planning.

meetups.date: 2026-12-16 · 6 p.m. · H.R. MacMillan Space Centre, Vancouver
meetups.title: Vancouver AI community meets at the Space Centre
meetups.description: BC + AI’s monthly gathering welcomes builders, researchers, artists, students and founders to exchange ideas and show work. Doors open at 6 p.m., with the program starting at 7; registration is through the organizer.

dining.date: From 2026-11-13 · Loam Bistro, 230 Esplanade West, North Vancouver
dining.title: Loam adds a weekend small-plates menu
dining.description: Loam Bistro’s Golden Hour runs Friday through Sunday from 3 to 5 p.m. The new menu includes chili-garlic prawns, banana-leaf fish and beef tartare toast; the restaurant plans to rotate dishes seasonally.
